text:
meera: Auditor asked for a compact artifact showing the full chain: alert -> ticket -> RBAC change -> KMS key use for the 2025-02-14 incident. They want something we can hand off tomorrow morning. Minimal and auditable.

alex: We should stitch Datadog alert snapshot, Jira ticket export (SEC-xxxx), IAM change log, and CloudTrail KMS events. Correlate by alert id / ticket id. I can script a small bundle. :thumbsup:

sanjay: For IAM changes Splunk/Cloud logging query I usually run:

```
index=cloudtrail eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters, awsRegion, resources
```

That returns role bindings + who triggered.

jess: Don’t forget to include the terraform plan/PR that resulted in the role change. Auditor wants proof of approval chain. e.g. commit: `git@github.com:redwood/repo.git@ab12cd3` and PR link. Also redact emails and session tokens from logs.

auditor_erin: Quick Q: For evidence, do you provide full raw logs or hashed snapshots? We prefer signed snapshots + a manifest with hashes so we can verify integrity, but can accept raw logs if redacted. Also need retention policy proof (where logs are stored, retention days).

meera: Plan: create a tarball with: `datadog/alert-<id>.json`, `jira/SEC-1024.json`, `iam/role_changes.json.gz`, `cloudtrail/kms_events.json.gz`, `repo/pr-1234.meta`. Add `manifest.txt` with sha256 hashes and a short readme mapping files to the audit control IDs. Will pre-sign S3 links for 7 days.

alex: Example CloudTrail KMS line to include as sample (redacted):

```
{
  "eventTime": "2025-02-14T03:12:45Z",
  "eventName": "Encrypt",
  "userIdentity": { "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/service-role/example" },
  "resources": [{ "ARN": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" }],
  "requestParameters": { "encryptionContext": { "ticket_id": "SEC-1024" } }
}
```

sanjay: Important: correlate `ticket_id` found in encryptionContext with the Jira ticket. If encryptionContext not present, use request parameters and resource ARNs and timestamp window +/- 5m. Also pull KMS key rotation metadata and key policy snapshot for the key used.

jess: For retention proof, include the S3 lifecycle policy and Splunk index TTL screenshot (or export). e.g. `s3://redwood-logs/cloudtrail/ -> lifecycle: 365d` and `splunk:index=cloudtrail retention=400d`.

auditor_erin: That sounds good. Also include a short narrative (1 page) that maps each file to the SOC2/ISO control ID and what it proves. We don't need interactive queries if you give us the artifacts + manifest + narrative.

opsbot: Ticket created: SEC-1024 "Investigate alert -> key usage mapping" assigned to @meera. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1024

meera: I'll assemble tonight. Deliverables: tarball + manifest + one-page mapping PDF + pre-signed links. Will sanitize PII and include hash manifest. Target upload by EOD PST for handoff tomorrow AM. Any blockers?

alex: I'll help with the Datadog snapshot and a one-liner that pulls the alert JSON: `curl -H "DD-API-KEY: $KEY" \"https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/alerts/<alert_id>\"`

sanjay: I'll export the Splunk query results and the CloudTrail KMS events. Will include the key policy JSON for the key id.

jess: I'll fetch the PR/commit proof and redact author emails in the artifact. Also produce the short narrative mapping to control IDs.

auditor_erin: Great — once we have the manifest and pre-signed links we can validate hashes and mark evidence as received. Thanks team.

meera: Thanks — uploading by 23:00 PST. If anyone drops artifacts in `s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/SEC-1024/` please ping me here with the object key so I can include the presigned link.
